d.title: Genmukan
d.en: Genmukan: The Sin of Desire & Shame
syn: Genmukan: Aiyoku to Ryoujoku no Intsumi
d.synopsis: Detective Satoru Kido is brought to a luxurious mansion to search for a lost jewel, but soon realizes there's more than meets the eye with the current lolita Mistress, the willing maid, the classic butler, the fugly manservant, and the sexy tutor.
